description.p: ZenGui is a desktop explorer for a live Zenoh bus, built with the Iced toolkit. It subscribes key-agnostically, so it sees the wire as it really is, and enriches what it finds with keyspace-v2 (zenkey) structure where the deployment provides it.

ul.li: Live subscription across the whole keyspace, or a chosen base
Payload decoding: protobuf (served descriptor sets), CDR and JSON
Keyspace-v2 enrichment: producers, slices and schemas
Contexts shared with the zenctl command-line explorer

description.p: zengui 0.6.0: the session is a Zenoh client by default (no listener, no multicast unless the config states it); a dead router is a link error at once, and --registry directories still load without a bus.
zengui 0.5.2: reads registry directories in either spelling, TOML or KDL, and says an introspect reply was unreadable, naming its encoding, instead of drawing it as no reply.
zengui 0.5.1: the registry facts line shows a subject's condition (when) and its exposure.
zengui 0.5.0: compare a key against a saved snapshot, an on-demand Consumers section, and pane replay that seeds its state from a version-2 capture and marks the trigger.
zengui 0.4.0: the registry facts line shows a subject's declared kind, and the doctor panel's run-over-run delta comes from the engine.
